title: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for Process Mining (Technical Report)
benchmark_measurement: Bias detection based on a 'religious' attribute in a hiring process dataset. The evaluation involved prompting the LLM to generate an SQL query to identify a 'protected group' based on sensitive attributes, which included religion.
findings: When tasked with identifying protected groups in a hiring dataset for a fairness assessment, GPT-4 included the 'religious' attribute in its SQL query (Listing 17), suggesting it recognized religion as a potential basis for discrimination. The paper did not delve deeper into the model's performance on this specific attribute compared to others.
